lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Ordered matrix of circular high-luminance pixel clusters. Distribution shows approximately 5 horizontal rows and 9 vertical columns posterior to the gill region. Centroids exhibit uniform spacing with a slight increase in inter-centroid distance moving posteriorly.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect horizontal rows of circular blobs, creating a grid of anchor nodes. Intersections are characterized by a localized increase in pixel intensity at the center of each node.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features are visible on the lateral flank. Each feature exhibits a sharp vertical gradient transition from high-intensity pixels on the dorsal edge to low-intensity pixels on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Visible high-luminance elongated anomaly attached to the ventral-lateral surface below the mid-flank, exhibiting a distinct silhouette from the shark's body.
